work.title: Challenge B cash-event semantics rerun and oracle-availability boundary
authority: Direct user instruction: proceed to the next existing-corpus priority.
Direct user decision: use 2026-08-31 as Challenge B subsequentCashEnd.

intent.productGoal: Preserve healthcare cash-event source semantics and malformed financial evidence without silent normalization or unsupported conclusions.
intent.capability: Rerun the staged Challenge B corpus under immutable scope, confirm typed payer/patient/partial/recoupment event behavior and malformed-adjustment quarantine, retain controls and gate authority, and determine whether a post-run truth contract exists.
architecturalIntent: Source event labels and canonical cash-event types remain separately observable.
Malformed source data remains quarantined rather than inferred into adjustment events.
Absence of a truth contract is an evidence limitation, not a prompt to manufacture expected output.
invariants: The A/R difference remains visible and release stays blocked.
No source identifiers or dates are invented for malformed adjustment rows.
Recoupment is not relabeled as reversal.
acceptanceEvidence: Run 1ddd85d4-7915-46c6-96b4-78b0ef9ff5ba from unchanged Challenge B archive.
Run-bound cash mix, quarantine, reconciliation, and gate observations.
Post-run complete archive inventory confirming no truth-oracle contract is supplied.

decisions.decision: Treat Challenge B as a cash-event semantic proof rather than a provider-departure or reversal scenario.
decisions.rationale: The actual source labels establish payer, patient, partial-payment, and recoupment behavior; no reversal label is present.

decisions.decision: Record oracle absence as a claim boundary rather than create comparison values.
decisions.rationale: The extracted package contains no truth-oracle artifact, expected-results file, or manifest.

observedBehaviour: event_type mapped authoritatively to payment_type and the cash mix preserved payer, patient, partial-payment, and negative recoupment events.
Seven malformed adjustment rows remained quarantined for Missing adjustment ID; no financial evidence was normalized.
Three cash controls matched, the $5,965.03 A/R difference remained visible, G4 passed, and G7 remained blocked.
The full post-run archive extraction contains seven source files and no truth-oracle contract.

evidence.result: Run binds event mapping, cash mix, quarantine, reconciliation, finding, gates, and draft workbook.
Complete seven-file extraction contains no Validation_Truth.csv, expected-results file, manifest, or other truth contract.
Records source-semantic proof, retained difference/quarantine, draft export, and oracle-availability boundary.

divergences.expected: A challenge closure can include a post-run truth-oracle comparison.
divergences.observed: Challenge B supplies no truth-oracle artifact or expected-results contract in the unchanged archive.

learning.recurringPattern: Source-semantic proof packages may contain sufficient deterministic evidence while omitting an independent aggregate-output oracle.
learning.improvementProposal: Author a separate Challenge B truth contract before claiming external oracle-verified aggregate output.
durableKnowledge: Challenge B proves recoupment, not reversal, behavior.
Malformed adjustments retain an evidence/quarantine boundary even when cash controls match.
Oracle absence limits only the oracle claim; it does not erase observed source-semantic, control, or governance evidence.
